tables.name: Ordon Naming Method
tables.description: Five historically layered British-inspired naming approaches; 62% old/inherited land & founders, 30% Victorian industry & transport, 8% individual civic/inherited names. Exact d100 weights; user-editable fictional setting content.

results.name: Old English & Landscape
results.description: Inherited woodland, terrain, agricultural and early medieval place-name compounds.

results.name: Founders, Manors & Estates
results.description: Names derived from early occupants, landholding families and estate forms; occasional Norman influence.

results.name: Victorian Works & Industry
results.description: Industrial villages and towns named after productive materials, workshops, mining and mill environments.

results.name: Railways, Canals & Market Roads
results.description: Later commercial and transport names commemorating roads, stations, wharves, markets and canal infrastructure.

results.name: Parish, Civic & Inherited Names
results.description: Curated established place names and a few later civic, parish or commemorative formations.
